def check_takahashi_statement():
    c = []
    for _ in range(3):
        row = list(map(int, input().split()))
        c.append(row)
    
    # Extract first row and first column
    first_row = [c[0][j] for j in range(3)]
    first_col = [c[i][0] for i in range(3)]
    
    # Check if the rest of the elements can be formed by subtracting the first row and column elements
    for i in range(1, 3):
        for j in range(1, 3):
            if c[i][j] != first_row[j] - first_col[i]:
                print("No")
                return
    
    print("Yes")
